games.payoutNote: Cash POP is not a "match count" game: you choose any number of the 15 numbers to play (1 up to all 15, "Cover All"), one number is drawn, and you win if the drawn number is among your chosen set. The dollar prize is NOT determined by how many numbers you chose — it's a random multiplier of your wager (5x-250x at $1, confirmed from the official Hoosier Lottery Prizes & Odds table) assigned per ticket at play time, which this app has no way to know from the public draw results alone. The table above shows the $1-wager reference multipliers/odds for information only; the app can only tell you whether your number matched, not your exact prize.
